items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I must say that I have never worked for such a clever guy as Benny Meroff.

ctx.x: He was a pretty famous band leader at that time---

Oh, boy - yes - a big money guy. And, he heard me play jazz choruses and he was looking for somebody just like me. And, he asked me if I would be interested. Well, who the hell wouldn't, to go with his big 30 piece symphony orchestra-styled band - you know - playing jazz -- he had a band within a band -- he had a dance band and he had a concert band and you played everything. And, so, I grabbed that. I couldn't resist that because that was something very special.
And, you stayed with him over five (5) years - didn't you?
